name: MixEval
intro: MixEval 是由 18 个现成带真值基准的开发/测试分片重构的动态文本评测。论文先用 Vicuna-33B 从 Common Crawl 检出约 200 万条候选用户查询，再由 GPT-4 Turbo 过滤、分类并保留文本输入/文本输出查询；随后用 all-mpnet-base-v2 归一化嵌入、Top-1 点积相似度与长度约束，将网页查询映射到源基准样本，论文目标为 4,000 条样本（95.15% 为英文）并保留源真值。
org: National University of Singapore, Carnegie Mellon University, Allen Institute for AI
build_method: Common Crawl 查询检测与过滤, 18 个带真值基准逐样本匹配, 三类动态更新
metric: 自由回答 0–1 分与选择题准确率按样本数加权的总分；Arena Elo 排名相关性仅用于跨模型元评估
eval_feature: 动态, 周期更新, 双分片
task_type_en: Multiple-choice Question Answering, Free-form Question Answering
build_method_en: Common Crawl query detection and filtering, sample-level matching over 18 ground-truth benchmarks, three dynamic-update paths
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, periodic updates, two released splits
intro_en: MixEval is a dynamic text evaluation reconstructed from the development and test splits of 18 off-the-shelf ground-truth benchmarks. The paper first uses Vicuna-33B to detect about 2 million candidate user queries from Common Crawl, then uses GPT-4 Turbo to filter/classify them and retain text-in/text-out queries. It next maps each web query to a source-benchmark item using normalized all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings, Top-1 dot-product similarity, and a length constraint. The paper target contains 4,000 items (95.15% English) and retains source ground truths.
scale_en: Paper/HF target: 4,000 samples (2,000 free-form + 2,000 multiple-choice); fixed Git Aug 2024 release: 3,995 (2,000 + 1,995)
metric_en: Sample-count-weighted overall score from free-form 0–1 scores and multiple-choice accuracy; Arena Elo rank correlation is across-model meta-evaluation only

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit fixed on 2026-07-18. The primary paper is arXiv:2406.06565v2 (12 October 2024); the reviewed PDF has SHA-256 26c94aa106bf898fa87ec4e6632136d81d879de78b2354f1b1e37c30dd450536. Sections 3.1-3.4, Figure 4, Table 1, Table 2, Section 4.1, Appendix A.5, and Appendix G were checked against the diagram. Construction begins with two query-detector benchmarks: one uses self-collected in-the-wild user queries as positives and non-query data such as Wikipedia as negatives; the higher-quality benchmark is author-handpicked. Prompted Vicuna-33B first reaches over 99% recall and detects about 20k candidates on a Common Crawl subset. GPT-4 relabels those candidates positive/negative, and the resulting data trains Vicuna-33B to over 99% recall and over 98% precision. The trained detector scans the full Common Crawl and finds about 2M queries; GPT-4 Turbo filters/classifies them and retains text-in/text-out queries. The benchmark pool contains development and test splits from exactly 18 ground-truth benchmarks: 12 general benchmarks (MMLU, BoolQ, HellaSwag, ARC, CommonSenseQA, AGIEval, OpenbookQA, GPQA, WinoGrande, TriviaQA, DROP, BBH) and six domain benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, MBPP, HumanEval, PIQA, SIQA). For each web query, the pipeline computes normalized all-mpnet-base-v2 sentence embeddings, ranks dot-product similarity, and takes the Top-1 source item subject to an input/context-length constraint. The paper target is 4,000 matched source items, 95.15% English, with source ground truths. The fixed Hugging Face revision contains 2,000 free-form and 2,000 multiple-choice rows. In the fixed Git tree, release 2024-06-01 likewise contains 2,000 plus 2,000 rows, while release 2024-08-11 contains 2,000 free-form and 1,995 multiple-choice rows (3,995 total); the diagram therefore labels 4,000 as the paper target rather than an invariant property of every released version. Dynamic refresh has three distinct paths: a different uniformly sampled web-query batch, a new source crawl using the latest Common Crawl, or expansion of the ground-truth benchmark pool. The paper reports five random-seed versions, update time under one minute, model-score standard deviation 0.36 on a 0-100 scale, 99.71% pairwise unique web queries, and 85.05% pairwise unique MixEval items. Evaluation semantics were checked at official repository commit 7c52b41929d461df7733573528bdfb08774b0c53. Chat models use official or FastChat templates and base models use 5-shot evaluation. GPT-3.5-Turbo-0125 is the default parser: free-form outputs receive an allowed score from 0.0 to 1.0 in [[score]] form, while multiple-choice outputs produce an option such as [[A]] and are exact-matched. The released parser retries unresolved items for 10 outer rounds; after that it randomly assigns a one-decimal free-form score or an MC option. A request blocked after 10 BadRequest events becomes 0.0 for free-form and a random option for MC. Randomness is seeded to 42. The reported overall score is the sample-count-weighted combination of the two released splits. Arena Elo rank correlation is a cross-model meta-evaluation and is not per-item grading. Release/open-source boundary: the fixed Git tree publishes evaluator code and dynamic data but no detector, Common Crawl mining, benchmark-mixture, or dynamic reconstruction implementation, and it has no repository LICENSE file (setup.py contains only an MIT classifier, not a license grant). The fixed Hugging Face dataset revision 66a05ec3821a2b5089ed1e32a5d65ab6ecdbf906 declares apache-2.0 in its dataset card. Therefore the site labels the benchmark partly public rather than fully public. The project homepage exposes a public leaderboard, but reproducibility is limited to released data/evaluation, not end-to-end construction. Formal publication evidence [site-a11v-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3285×825 (English) and 3285×825 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3283×823 and 3283×823. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
